CacheVolume.description:
DAH-2475: a persistent named docker volume mounted into a FILLER container (`name` must not use the
ephemeral `volume_` prefix).
CacheVolume.title: CacheVolume

ClusterMembership.description: DAH-2620: this pod is one node of a multi-node group rental; the backend mints the WireGuard mesh.
ClusterMembership.title: ClusterMembership

ContainerCreateRequest.description:
Create (or edit) a pod's container. Disk sizing: with `disk_share` set the validator sizes from
fresh on-host disk state and the two `*_limit_gb` are caps; without it they are exact sizes.
ContainerCreateRequest.title: ContainerCreateRequest

DefaultDockerImage.description:
One item of `GET /executors/default-docker-image`; parsed leniently so new backend fields never
break validation.
DefaultDockerImage.title: DefaultDockerImage

DefaultDockerImagesResponse.description: The backend returns a bare JSON list.
DefaultDockerImagesResponse.title: DefaultDockerImagesResponse

DuplicateExecutorsResponse.description: The backend's answer to `DuplicateExecutorsRequest`: executors by miner that share GPU uuids.
DuplicateExecutorsResponse.title: DuplicateExecutorsResponse

EstimateResponse.description: The validator's answer to the backend's `GetEstimateRequest` (backend_to_validator).
EstimateResponse.title: EstimateResponse

ExecutorSpecRequest.description:
One executor's result for one cycle. `specs` is the scraped machine description; the backend types
it as its `MachineSpecs`, the validator sends whatever the scraper produced, so the wire type is a
JSON object.
ExecutorSpecRequest.title: ExecutorSpecRequest

ForcedValidationCycleRequest.description: Staging only: start the validation cycle now. No executor — the cycle validates the whole fleet.
ForcedValidationCycleRequest.title: ForcedValidationCycleRequest

GetEstimateRequest.description:
Ask the validator for the exact incentive estimate of a node shape; answered by
`validator_to_backend.EstimateResponse` with the same `request_id`. The validator's copy has no
`message_type` field and ignores unknown keys, so the backend's copy having carried delivery stamps on
this message never mattered.
GetEstimateRequest.title: GetEstimateRequest

GpuPowerLimit.description:
DAH-2356: one GPU's power cap for the Lium PEARL default job; the validator rejects a non-positive
value at the boundary.
GpuPowerLimit.title: GpuPowerLimit

IncentiveReason.description:
One structured zero-incentive reason (DAH-2340). `reason` is an append-only machine-readable code
the backend keys off; `message_for_miner` is free text; `context` grows by key, never renames.
IncentiveReason.title: IncentiveReason

ManualRentalInfo.description: Specs a special manual (bare-metal) rental is force-passed against; both fields drive the score.
ManualRentalInfo.title: ManualRentalInfo

NetworkEMA.description: EMA-smoothed network speed measurements for an executor.
NetworkEMA.title: NetworkEMA

NvmlReportAckResponse.description: Ack for a reported unknown driver (DAH-2451); the body is intentionally near-empty.
NvmlReportAckResponse.title: NvmlReportAckResponse

PodHostRebootRecoveredRequest.description: `POST …/host-reboot-recovered`: the container exit the recovery reacted to.
PodHostRebootRecoveredRequest.title: PodHostRebootRecoveredRequest

RentedExecutorsResponse.description: `GET /internal/executors/rented`: every rented executor, the fillers to protect, the bans.
RentedExecutorsResponse.title: RentedExecutorsResponse

RentedMachineResponse.description: The answer to `RentedMachineRequest`: every rented machine and the current bans.
RentedMachineResponse.title: RentedMachineResponse

Response.description:
The backend's answer to `AuthenticateRequest`. The one strict model of the protocol: the validator's
copy forbids unknown keys and this mirrors it, so an unexpected key here is an error, not ignored.
Response.title: Response

WorkloadKind.description: What a container is for: a renter's pod or a Lium/miner default job (filler).
WorkloadKind.title: WorkloadKind
